cards.title: 10K Likes Milestone
cards.description: This post crossed 10,000 likes organically in under 48 hours — no promotion, no ads, just a genuine idea that resonated.
cards.highlight: 10K likes in 48 hours with zero ad spend.

cards.title: Trending Today
cards.description: Sitting at the top of the explore page for six hours straight. Real engagement from real people who found it worth sharing.
cards.highlight: Six hours on the explore page and still climbing.

cards.title: Community Favorite

cards.highlight: 8,000 saves and counting — still referenced weekly.

cards.title: Viral in 3 Hours

cards.title: Top Weekly Pick
cards.description: The highest-liked piece of content across the entire platform this week, beating out posts from accounts ten times the size.
cards.highlight: Beat accounts ten times bigger this week.

cards.title: 500 Comments
cards.description: A post that started a real conversation. Over 500 thoughtful comments, genuine debate, and follow-up threads still active.
cards.highlight: Comments still coming in three weeks later.

cards.title: Editor's Choice
cards.description: Hand-picked by the editorial team as an example of what great content on this platform looks and feels like.
cards.highlight: Held up by the editorial team as the gold standard.

cards.title: Most Bookmarked
cards.description: Bookmarked more than any other post this quarter. People keep coming back to it as a reference long after the initial spike.
cards.highlight: The post people keep returning to months later.

cards.title: Cross-Platform Hit
cards.description: Started on one platform and spread to five others within 24 hours. Screenshots, quote posts, and reposts across every major network.

cards.title: Record Engagement Rate
cards.description: A 34% engagement rate on a post with over 50K impressions — far beyond any benchmark and driven entirely by word of mouth.

cards.title: Influencer Reshared

cards.highlight: Two million eyes, zero outreach required.

cards.title: Evergreen Classic
cards.description: Published over a year ago and still pulling in hundreds of likes every week. The kind of content that never stops being relevant.
cards.highlight: A year old and still getting likes every single day.
